q: Why convert media to text once and store it?
options: To avoid resending costly images or audio every turn and to enable search

q: When might native multimodal input beat conversion to text?
options: When layout, tone or visual detail matter for the answer

q: What privacy issue is specific to multimodal inputs?
options: Photos, screens and recordings often contain personal data that is easy to overlook
explain: Apply the same controls as text.
